mapper.sql: id, user_id, file_name, file_path, file_size, file_type, status, chunk_strategy, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO documents (user_id, file_name, file_path, file_size, file_type, status, chunk_strategy) VALUES (#{userId}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{fileType}, #{status}, #{chunkStrategy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM documents WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND file_name = #{fileName} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM documents WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT FROM documents WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documents WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE documents SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
